features.label: Timeline Editor
features.notes: Multi-track timeline with clips, markers, snap, zoom, scrub

features.label: Media Library
features.notes: Upload + ingestion work. Missing: folders, bins, sub-bins, smart collections, ratings, relink

features.label: Mobile/Tablet Editor
features.notes: Responsive layout + dedicated mobile editor view. Missing: pinch-zoom, swipe-delete, haptics

features.label: PWA / Offline
features.notes: Service worker + manifest installed. Missing: offline render queue, conflict handling, restore UI

features.label: Multi-Track Timeline
features.notes: Audio multi-track amix works. Video overlay composite PARTIAL — single-track sequential xfade today

features.label: Ripple Trim
features.notes: V19.1 §25: src/lib/timeline/trim-operations.ts rippleTrim() — shifts downstream clips. Tested with exact boundary assertions.

features.label: Roll Trim
features.notes: V19.1 §25: rollEdit() — adjusts edit point between two adjacent clips. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Slip Trim
features.notes: V19.1 §25: slipEdit() — changes source in/out while preserving timeline position. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Slide Trim
features.notes: V19.1 §25: slideEdit() — moves clip while adjusting neighbors. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Lift (remove + leave gap)
features.notes: V19.1 §25: liftClip() — removes clip + leaves gap. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Extract (remove + close gap)
features.notes: V19.1 §25: extractClip() — removes clip + shifts downstream left. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Insert (shift downstream right)
features.notes: V19.1 §25: insertClip() — inserts clip + shifts downstream right. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Overwrite (replace region)
features.notes: V19.1 §25: overwriteClip() — overwrites region + trims/splits overlapping clips. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Extend clip
features.notes: V19.1 §25: extendClip() — extends duration where source permits. UI not yet wired.

features.label: Three-Point Editing
features.notes: V19.1 §27: in/out/source/target — supported via insert/overwrite with position params. No dedicated UI.

features.label: Keyframe Engine
features.notes: V19.1.4 §31: Keyframe engine (interpolation + expression generation) is verified by 24 unit tests + production render E2E (FFmpegRenderService.render() produces valid MP4 with keyframes). HOWEVER, the compositor-level X/Y application is PARTIAL — the overlay filter does not yet use the time-varying X/Y expression. Opacity/scale/rotation keyframes DO render. X/Y position keyframes are generated but not applied at the composite step.

features.label: Masking Engine
features.notes: V19 §21-22: buildFilterGraph emits MaskNode for rectangle/circle/ellipse/polygon/freehand. FFmpegRenderService uses geq filter with alpha formulas + gblur for feather + invert support. Mask keyframes via time-varying expressions. Missing: mask inspector UI in right-inspector.

features.label: Mask Keyframes
features.notes: V19 §22: MaskShape.keyframes field — time-varying x/y/w/h/feather via FFmpeg expressions

features.label: Chroma Key
features.notes: V19 §23: ChromaKey type (color/similarity/smoothness/spillSuppression/edgeSoftness/shadowPreservation). FFmpeg chromakey + colorchannelmixer for spill suppression. Missing: chroma-key UI inspector.

features.label: Color Grading
features.notes: V19 §30: 12 ColorAdjust fields render via eq+colorbalance+hue. highlights/shadows/whites/blacks via colorbalance midtones/shadows/highlights. saturation/vibrance via eq. temperature/tint via colorbalance red/blue shift.

features.label: RGB Curves
features.notes: V19 §30: ColorCurves type with master/red/green/blue control points. FFmpeg curves filter with parsed points. Missing: UI curve editor.

features.label: Color Wheels (Lift/Gamma/Gain)
features.notes: V19 §30: ColorWheels type. FFmpeg colorbalance with rs/gs/bs (shadows=lift), rm/gm/bm (midtones=gamma), rh/gh/bh (highlights=gain). Missing: UI wheel editor.

features.label: Video Scopes (Waveform/Vectorscope/RGB Parade/Histogram)
features.notes: V19.1 §24: src/lib/render/color-scopes.ts — extracts frames via FFmpeg + computes 4 scopes from real pixel data. PNG decoder (incl. filter un-application). Pure computeScopesFromPixels() for testing. UI not yet wired.

features.label: LUT (.cube) Support
features.notes: V19 §32: LutRef type (storageKey/filePath + intensity + interp). FFmpeg lut3d filter with tetrahedral interpolation. LUT files downloaded from storage to tmp + cached. UI button in elements-panel wired.

features.label: Effect Library
features.notes: 16 effects in UI. 9 render correctly. 7 silently no-op. Effect.params unused

features.label: Filter Library
features.notes: 11/11 filters render correctly via FFmpeg

features.label: Transition Engine
features.notes: 17 transitions in UI. 8 render via xfade. 9 silently fall back to fade

features.label: Caption System
features.notes: V19 §51: CaptionService with SRT/VTT/JSON parse+generate. Transcription E2E works. Multi-cue rendering via per-cue drawtext with enable=between(t,start,end). Per-cue styling (CaptionCueStyle). Word-level karaoke highlighting via per-word drawtext. Speaker labels.

features.label: Caption Templates (Karaoke/Bold social/Minimal/etc.)
features.notes: 7 caption styles in captions-panel UI. Each applies TextStyle overrides. Missing: persistent caption template presets (DB-backed).

features.label: Audio Engine
features.notes: V19 §33: Per-clip volume/pan/fades render via afade+volume+pan. Multi-track amix composites. fadeOut bug FIXED (chain duration threaded through AudioMixNode). Missing: EQ, compressor, limiter, de-esser, noise reduction, voice isolation, ducking — these are advanced audio effects not yet wired.

features.label: Voice Recording
features.notes: Microphone → MediaRecorder → multipart POST /api/assets/upload → MediaAsset → timeline

features.label: AI Command Engine
features.notes: V19 §42: 17-command Zod schema + canonical executor.ts (handles all 17). ai-panel.tsx NOW imports executeCommands from canonical executor (previously had local applyCommands that only handled 4). Single history entry wraps all mutations.

features.label: AI Transcription
features.notes: OpenAI/Deepgram/Test providers + deterministic transcription identity + worker lease

features.label: Text-Based Editing (transcript-driven deletion)
features.notes: V19.1 §33: src/lib/ai/text-editing.ts — deleteSentence/deleteWord/deleteSilence/deleteFillerWords. Splits clips + shifts downstream left. Processes right-to-left to preserve positions. 8 unit tests pass.

features.label: Auto Reframe (subject-aware reframing)
features.notes: V19.1 §29: src/lib/render/auto-reframe.ts — samples frames + detects subject (zai VLM when configured, deterministic center fallback) + smooths motion + generates transform keyframes. Supports 16:9 → 9:16, 1:1, 4:5.

features.label: AI Highlight Detection
features.notes: V19.1 §34: src/lib/ai/highlight-detection.ts — uses real signals (audio peaks via FFmpeg astats, scene changes via FFmpeg select filter, transcript keyword analysis) to identify highlight segments. NO fake responses.

features.label: AI Shorts Generator
features.notes: V19.1 §35: src/lib/ai/highlight-detection.ts generateShorts() — takes highlights → produces short candidates with 9:16 reframing + caption cues + suggested project titles.

features.label: Template Engine
features.notes: V19: TemplateDefinition + slots + applySlotToClip + autoFillSlots + sanitizeTemplateData. 6 builtin templates (TikTok/Reels/YouTube Intro/Birthday/Product Demo/Cinematic). API: GET /api/templates (search+filter+sort), GET /api/templates/[id], POST /api/templates/[id]/use. Real ranking via computeTemplateRank (usage/likes/saves/shares/completionRate).

features.label: Template Marketplace
features.notes: V19 §13: tier field (free/premium/creator_exclusive/sponsored/enterprise/brand) in schema. NO payment integration yet

features.label: Template Creator Program
features.notes: V19 §11: CreatorProfile model + program status (none/applied/approved/rejected/suspended). NO UI yet

features.label: Template Versioning
features.notes: V19 §12: TemplateVersion model exists. version + parentTemplateId fields on Template. NO API to fetch old versions yet

features.label: Template License Management
features.notes: V19 §14: license JSON field on Template (type, commercialUse, attributionRequired, musicRights, stockRights, territory, expiration)

features.label: Template Auto-Fill
features.notes: V19 §17: autoFillSlots() — assigns user assets round-robin + pulls brand-kit tokens

features.label: Template Analytics
features.notes: V19 §77: TemplateAnalytics model tracks view/use/like/save/share/complete/abandon events. POST /api/templates/[id]/use increments usageCount + creates analytics row.

features.label: Project Sharing
features.notes: ProjectShare + Comment Prisma models exist. ShareDialog is UI shell. NO API endpoints

features.label: Project Versioning
features.notes: ProjectVersion model exists. Manual versions endpoint exists. Missing: auto-versions, restore, compare

features.label: Export Engine
features.notes: FFmpegRenderService with streaming upload + ffprobe validation + idempotent dedup + cancellation + heartbeat

features.label: Codec Support (H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1)
features.notes: H.264 implemented. H.265/VP9/AV1 are presences in code but FFmpeg encoding params not wired for all

features.label: Social Export Presets
features.notes: 8 presets in types.ts + 7 in export-dialog.tsx — IDs mismatch. Need consolidation + add TikTok/Reels/Shorts/etc.

features.label: Cloud Rendering (BullMQ)
features.notes: Redis + BullMQ + worker + FFmpeg + object storage + crash recovery (v17.1)

features.label: S3/R2 Production Storage
features.notes: StorageProvider abstraction + Local/S3/R2 + UploadIntent + finalize + multipart upload

features.label: PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL Certification

features.notes: Thumbnails + waveforms generated during ingestion. Missing: frame cache, proxy cache, WebCodecs/WebGPU compositing
